title: chart-triage
intention: Stage 5 of the /chart chain: the TRIAGE brick. One narrow question: what matters FIRST, and by what stated standard? Not what the pieces are (decompose), not what outcome each will have (hypothesize). The packet's ORDER is a complete permutation of the berthed split's pieces — position IS the rank (no numeric priority field to drift against it), every entry naming its piece verbatim and carrying its why_now. Three strata: FLOOR — template-filled from the berthed decompose packet (the chain deepens to depth 5: triage -> decompose -> survey -> constrain -> orient, re-checked whole by composing decompose's own chain reader BY IDENTITY — each stage owns exactly one new link), handing the ceiling the intent, the bounds, the sub_problems verbatim, the split's unknowns, and the judges' vocabulary (piece_whats — the exact multiset the order must cover); TREE — the triage brick's own corpus through the generalized verbs; CEILING — the ranking judgment itself, per-field provenance. Built UNDER the pre-installed judges (ticket triage-filters): the berth door composes judge_triage by identity; the module cannot shape its own acceptance.
why: Triage is where the derived work meets the builder's reflexes. The dated failures are ranking-shaped: the 2026-07-24 done-while-unmoved substitution (the expensive implied piece silently dropped) and the standing get-it-right-not-cheap CC-- (the cheap-first reflex hiding in unstated standards); the 2026-07-23 solidify-the-layer-below ruling is the proof that the honest order often INVERTS the appealing one and only a stated why makes that inversion adjudicable. The coverage multiset makes dropping physics-refused, and the forced why_now makes the standard travel with the rank. Position-is-rank keeps one copy of the truth (Law 1: a rank field beside a list order is two copies that drift).
traces_to: Law 1 — the ranked order is compiled once, in one place; the tree remembers how this class of request ranks
Law 3 — every rank is a claim with its standard stated; the coverage check measures it against the berthed split
Law 4 — the judges + schema make a dropped or invented piece a build error, not a lapse
Law 8 — the brick's first berthed packet passes judges it did not write (triage-filters, the live gate)

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: test_chart_triage.py (chain physics at depth 5 — refuses without a readable decompose berth, and a broken link anywhere below refuses loudly; floor hands the pieces and the coverage vocabulary verbatim from the berth; schema gate refuses hollow shapes; door composes judge_triage BY IDENTITY; berth round-trips; deposit-back gated; import allowlist over import_map) under the tester's netns seal. Live gate: a real triage packet for THIS ticket berths through judges the module did not write, deposits back, and registers on the dial.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: stage 5 filling from the conversation instead of the berthed stage-4 file; the floor re-walking the chain in parallel instead of composing decompose's reader; an order that drops, invents, or double-orders a piece passing the door; the door and the promotion gate disagreeing; the dial unable to read a triage berth; the deposit-back seeding the tree with a packet whose berth is not on disk.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when hypothesize lands (stage 6 template-fills from this berth); when a real ranking needs parallel tracks or a partial order (triage-filters edge (a) — a design event); when /moreabout signals show triage fields recurrently too compressed.
